review_candidates.title: Senior Solutions Architect - Europe
review_candidates.description: Job Description Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. Note: this is a remote role that is to be based out of one of the following countries: United Kingdom Ireland Switzerland Spain The Opportunity Deepgram is expanding globally and building a true follow‑the‑sun model. We are hiring a Solutions Architect in EMEA to own complex post‑sales engagements, guide customers to production, and strengthen our technical support coverage for the region. You will work across the full customer lifecycle, with a primary focus on architecture, implementation, and Tier‑3 technical problem solving. You will also contribute to pre‑sales validation when deep technical credibility is needed, partner with Product and Engineering on feedback and roadmap, and help mature our global operations. About Applied Engineering At Deepgram Applied Engineering combines functions that other companies split across Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Consulting, and Senior Technical Support. We are the technical interface from first discovery through successful production and beyond. The team partners closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and DevRel to deliver an enterprise‑grade experience that is fast, clear, and outcome‑oriented. What You’ll Do Lead architecture and implementation for enterprise deployments that use Deepgram’s speech‑to‑text, text‑to‑speech, and voice‑agent capabilities. Own post‑sales technical success for assigned accounts. Unblock integrations, optimize accuracy and latency, and guide customers to stable production. Serve as the Tier‑3 escalation point for complex issues. Drive root cause analysis, propose mitigations, and write durable fixes or automation when possible. Design reference architectures and implementation patterns for common EMEA customer use cases including contact centers, voice analytics, QA, and AI agents. Build high‑quality samples, internal tools, or scripts that make repeatable tasks easier for customers and for our team. Contribute to pre‑sales discovery and POCs when deep technical direction is needed. Translate business goals to a concrete plan with clear success criteria. Partner with Product and Engineering to prioritize fixes and features. Bring crisp customer signals that improve our roadmap. Contribute to knowledge systems. Capture runbooks, playbooks, and docs that scale your expertise across regions. Participate in an on‑call or incident rotation appropriate for the region and customer support tier. Help us meet or outperform regional SLAs. Regional Expectations Based in an EMEA time zone with reliable overlap to customer business hours. Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a strong plus. Familiarity with GDPR, data privacy expectations, and enterprise security reviews common across EMEA. Ability to travel within the region for critical customer milestones, estimated 10–20 percent. Your First 90 Days First 30 days Ramp on Deepgram’s platform, APIs, SDKs, self-hosted deployments, and support practices. Shadow calls across pre-sales, post-sales, and support. Begin owning low-risk technical tasks for an active account and contribute improvements to runbooks or sample code. By day 60 Own two to three customer workstreams end-to-end. Lead discovery for one new implementation or migration. Publish one reusable asset such as a deployment guide, Helm example, or troubleshooting playbook. By day 90 Act as primary technical owner for several EMEA accounts in production. Close at least one complex investigation with measurable customer impact. Present a short readout on a repeated regional pattern and the automation or content you created to solve it. You’ll Thrive Here If You Enjoy solving hard customer problems at the code, container, and cloud layers. Like translating messy real‑world constraints into clear architectures and plans. Are comfortable writing and reading production‑grade code, not just sample snippets. Value crisp documentation, reproducible runbooks, and operational excellence. Care about delivering outcomes, not just closing tickets. Minimum Qualifications 5 or more years in Solutions Architecture, Solutions Engineering, or similar customer‑facing technical roles. Professional software engineering experience in at least one language such as Python, Rust, or JavaScript. You can build POCs and tools that real users run. Hands‑on experience with modern cloud platforms. Comfortable with containerization and orchestration, for example Docker and Kubernetes, and with secure network design for API‑driven systems. Proven ownership of complex post‑sales work such as production deployments, migrations, performance tuning, and incident response. Clear written and verbal communication across both technical and executive audiences. Preferred Qualifications Experience with speech recognition, TTS, or building voice agents that orchestrate LLMs. Familiarity with WER analysis, model selection and tuning, and accuracy‑versus‑latency tradeoffs. Experience operating self‑hosted systems, including Helm‑based deployments and observability for production services. Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, data residency, and compliance topics that appear in EMEA enterprise reviews. Fluency in an additional European language such as German, French, Dutch, Italian, or Spanish. How We Work Remote across EMEA with periodic regional meetups. Collaboration with colleagues in the Americas and APAC to support continuous coverage. Shared playbooks, defined escalation paths, and measurable SLAs. Interview Process Recruiter screen focused on experience, motivations, and logistics. Hiring manager conversation focused on technical depth and customer impact. Technical assessment that mirrors real work. Expect practical coding, architecture discussion, and debugging. Panel interviews with cross‑functional partners. A presentation simulating a post-sales customer engagement, based on a provided case study. Additionally, you’ll be asked to present a past customer‑facing technical engagement that you led, including the problem, your approach, and measurable outcomes. If this sounds like you, we would love to meet you! Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

review_candidates.title: Senior Nostro Account Investigation Specialist
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Senior Nostro Account Investigation Specialist Location: United Arab Emirates (Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time Work Arrangement: 100% Remote — Work From Home Level: Senior About the Role The Senior Nostro Account Investigation Specialist is responsible for investigating, reconciling, and resolving discrepancies in correspondent banking accounts maintained by financial institutions with other banks. The role focuses on identifying unmatched transactions, analyzing payment flows, investigating settlement differences, resolving aged outstanding items, and strengthening reconciliation controls. Working fully remotely, the specialist collaborates with treasury operations, correspondent banking teams, payment operations, finance, and international banking partners to maintain accurate Nostro balances, reduce operational risk, and support timely settlement processes. Key Responsibilities Manage complex investigations involving Nostro account balances, transaction discrepancies, and unreconciled entries. Perform detailed reconciliations between internal general ledger records, Nostro statements, and correspondent bank transaction reports. Investigate unmatched credits, debits, duplicate entries, missing transactions, incorrect references, and unexpected account movements. Analyze SWIFT messages, payment confirmations, bank statements, and settlement records to identify the causes of discrepancies. Review relevant payment message formats, including MT103, MT202, MT940, MT950, and applicable ISO 20022 messages. Trace cross-border payments and investigate delays, misdirected funds, rejected transactions, and incomplete settlement information. Coordinate remotely with correspondent banks, intermediary banks, internal payment teams, and treasury operations to resolve outstanding items. Investigate foreign exchange differences, value-date mismatches, bank charges, incorrect postings, and settlement timing variations. Monitor aged reconciliation items and prioritize investigations according to financial exposure, operational impact, and resolution deadlines. Maintain comprehensive investigation records, supporting evidence, correspondence, and resolution documentation. Identify recurring transaction exceptions and recommend improvements to payment processing and reconciliation procedures. Support root cause analysis of Nostro breaks and develop corrective action recommendations. Review suspense account balances and investigate entries associated with unresolved Nostro discrepancies. Monitor correspondent banking transaction patterns and identify unusual movements requiring further investigation. Coordinate escalation of suspected fraud, sanctions concerns, payment irregularities, and potential financial crime indicators through established control channels. Support daily, monthly, and period-end reconciliation activities by ensuring outstanding items are accurately classified and tracked. Prepare management reports covering unreconciled balances, investigation ageing, settlement exceptions, and resolution performance. Review reconciliation procedures, operational controls, and investigation workflows for compliance with internal policies. Support internal and external audit requests by providing accurate reconciliation evidence and investigation histories. Contribute to automation initiatives involving transaction matching, exception identification, reconciliation platforms, and investigation workflow management. Provide technical guidance to junior reconciliation and payment investigation personnel. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Banking, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline. Significant experience in Nostro reconciliation, correspondent banking, payment investigations, treasury operations, or bank settlement functions. Strong understanding of Nostro and Vostro accounts and correspondent banking relationships. Experience investigating unreconciled transactions, payment discrepancies, settlement differences, and outstanding account items. Practical knowledge of SWIFT payment messaging, including MT103, MT202, MT940, MT950, and ISO 20022 formats. Understanding of international payment clearing, settlement processes, value dates, intermediary bank charges, and foreign exchange transactions. Experience with general ledger reconciliation, suspense account investigation, and financial transaction matching. Familiarity with banking reconciliation platforms, core banking systems, payment processing systems, and correspondent banking tools. Knowledge of operational risk management, internal controls, and financial transaction monitoring. Awareness of anti-money laundering, sanctions screening, fraud prevention, and suspicious transaction escalation requirements. Strong analytical and investigative skills, including the ability to trace complex payment flows. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; knowledge of SQL, data analytics, or reconciliation automation tools is an advantage. Excellent written communication and stakeholder coordination skills. Strong organizational skills and ability to manage high volumes of investigations within strict deadlines. Ability to work independently and collaborate with international banking teams in a fully remote environment. What We Offer Fully remote working arrangement within the stated UAE-based role framework. Opportunity to work with international correspondent banking and treasury operations. Collaboration with payment operations, finance, compliance, and global banking professionals. Exposure to modern reconciliation platforms, SWIFT messaging, and cross-border payment systems. Opportunities for professional development in treasury operations and banking risk management. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting their Nostro reconciliation experience, correspondent banking knowledge, payment investigation capabilities, and familiarity with SWIFT messaging and settlement systems. Application Subject: Application – Senior Nostro Account Investigation Specialist (UAE Remote) Candidates should confirm applicable employment arrangements, residency requirements, and work authorization before accepting an offer. This is a fully remote reconciliation, transaction investigation, data analysis, and documentation role. Physical cash handling, in-person banking procedures, and local payment processing activities must be performed by qualified local personnel where required. Binding payment approvals, settlement release authorizations, credit decisions, sanctions determinations, regulatory notifications, and formal financial reporting sign-offs must be undertaken by appropriately authorized banking, treasury, or compliance professionals in accordance with applicable regulations and delegated authority policies.

review_candidates.title: Senior Histopathology Slide Quality Specialist
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Senior Histopathology Slide Quality Specialist Location: United Arab Emirates (Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time Work Arrangement: 100% Remote — Work From Home Level: Senior About the Role The Senior Histopathology Slide Quality Specialist is responsible for providing remote technical quality oversight of histopathology slide preparation, staining consistency, digital slide integrity, and laboratory quality documentation. The role focuses on reviewing digital slide images, assessing technical artifacts, monitoring quality indicators, investigating recurring preparation and staining issues, and supporting continuous improvement across histopathology workflows. Working remotely, the specialist collaborates with pathologists, histotechnologists, laboratory quality teams, and diagnostic operations personnel to strengthen slide quality, traceability, and consistency. Physical laboratory procedures and diagnostic interpretations remain the responsibility of appropriately qualified local personnel. Key Responsibilities Review digitized histopathology slides for technical quality, image clarity, tissue representation, and suitability for professional review. Assess digital slide images for common technical artifacts, including folds, tears, chatter, compression, staining irregularities, air bubbles, and focus-related issues. Evaluate slide preparation and staining quality using documented laboratory criteria and approved quality standards. Review hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining consistency and, where applicable, special stains and immunohistochemistry outputs. Identify recurring slide quality defects and investigate potential contributing factors through remote data and documentation review. Monitor quality indicators relating to tissue sectioning, staining consistency, slide completeness, labeling accuracy, and digital scanning performance. Review digital pathology images for scanning artifacts, incomplete tissue capture, image stitching defects, and inadequate resolution. Assess slide and specimen traceability records for consistency across laboratory information systems and associated documentation. Support the development and maintenance of histopathology slide quality checklists, review criteria, and standard operating procedures. Analyze quality control trends and prepare reports on recurring technical defects, corrective actions, and improvement opportunities. Collaborate remotely with histotechnologists and laboratory supervisors to investigate slide preparation and staining discrepancies. Review nonconformance records, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) documentation, and quality improvement reports. Support root cause analysis of recurring slide quality failures and recommend practical process improvements. Evaluate the consistency of slide quality across different laboratories, staining platforms, and digital pathology systems. Assist with remote quality assessments of digital pathology workflows and image management processes. Review documentation relating to equipment maintenance, staining reagent quality, process monitoring, and internal quality controls. Contribute to internal audit preparation and quality management reviews involving histopathology operations. Support the implementation of standardized slide acceptance and rejection criteria. Provide technical guidance and training materials on slide quality assessment, artifact recognition, and documentation practices. Maintain accurate records of digital slide reviews, identified defects, quality findings, and recommendations. Monitor relevant developments in digital pathology technology, histology quality practices, and laboratory quality management standards. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Medical Laboratory Science, Histotechnology, Biomedical Science, Pathology Laboratory Technology, or a related discipline. Significant experience in histopathology laboratory operations, histology quality assurance, slide preparation oversight, or digital pathology quality review. Strong understanding of histological tissue processing, embedding, microtomy, staining, and slide preparation workflows. Knowledge of H&E staining principles, special stains, and immunohistochemistry quality requirements. Experience identifying common histopathology slide artifacts and assessing their impact on technical slide quality. Familiarity with digital pathology scanners, whole-slide imaging systems, and digital image review platforms. Understanding of tissue specimen traceability, slide labeling, laboratory documentation, and quality control requirements. Experience with laboratory quality management systems, nonconformance reporting, CAPA, and root cause analysis. Familiarity with relevant laboratory quality standards, including ISO 15189 principles, where applicable. Ability to evaluate technical slide quality without independently making clinical diagnoses or issuing pathology interpretations. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail when reviewing digital images and laboratory quality records. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and laboratory information management systems. Ability to prepare clear technical reports, quality summaries, and corrective action recommendations. Strong communication and coordination skills when working with pathologists, laboratory technologists, and quality teams. Ability to manage multiple quality review activities independently in a fully remote environment. What We Offer Fully remote working arrangement within the stated UAE-based role framework. Opportunity to contribute to histopathology quality improvement and digital pathology development. Collaboration with experienced laboratory, pathology, and quality assurance professionals. Exposure to digital slide imaging technologies and laboratory quality management systems. Opportunities for professional development in histotechnology quality assurance and digital pathology operations. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting their histopathology experience, slide quality assessment expertise, digital pathology knowledge, and laboratory quality assurance background. Application Subject: Application – Senior Histopathology Slide Quality Specialist (UAE Remote) Candidates should confirm applicable employment arrangements, residency requirements, and work authorization before accepting an offer. This is a fully remote technical quality oversight and digital slide review position. Physical specimen collection, tissue processing, embedding, sectioning, staining, slide preparation, laboratory equipment operation, and on-site inspections must be performed by qualified local laboratory personnel. Clinical diagnosis, pathological interpretation, selection of patient treatment, and diagnostic sign-offs must remain with appropriately licensed pathologists or other authorized healthcare professionals.

review_candidates.title: Rust Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Company Oho Group Ltd is recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing, well-backed technology start-up in London. The company is building performance-critical software where engineering decisions have a direct impact on speed, memory use, concurrency and reliability. Rust is central to its engineering culture and product development, not a secondary technology used only for selected components. The engineering team is focused on creating innovative software for real-world applications and is interested in emerging areas such as artificial intelligence and machine learning. Engineers joining the business will have the opportunity to contribute to greenfield development, work alongside highly skilled colleagues and help shape software from its foundations. This is an in-office position in London, designed for people who value close collaboration and active participation in a fast-moving team. About The Role Oho Group Ltd is seeking a Rust Engineer, or an exceptional software engineer ready to make Rust the primary focus of their career. This role is suited to someone who cares deeply about how software is designed, built and maintained, and who is motivated to understand the principles behind the technologies they use. You will design and implement high-performance systems, work through complex technical challenges and take ownership of projects from initial architecture through implementation. You will contribute to a codebase where performance, memory safety, concurrency and reliability are deliberate engineering priorities. The successful candidate will bring strong problem-solving skills, sound technical judgment and the enthusiasm to grow in a demanding, collaborative environment. Professional Rust experience is welcome, but the opportunity may also suit a strong systems or software engineer whose Rust experience has so far been limited to personal projects or occasional use. What matters is a solid engineering foundation, a genuine commitment to mastering Rust and the ability to apply that learning to production-quality software. Qualifications We are looking for candidates who are passionate about Rust and eager to use it as a core part of their professional work. You may already have substantial experience building production systems in Rust, or you may be an accomplished engineer in C++, Python, Java, C#, Go or another relevant language who is ready to make a focused transition. Strong candidates will demonstrate excellent problem-solving ability and experience working in fast-paced engineering environments. They will be curious about how programming languages, systems and underlying technologies behave, rather than treating tools as black boxes. An interest in artificial intelligence, machine learning or other cutting-edge areas is welcome. You should also be comfortable working in the office in London and collaborating closely with a specialist engineering team. Responsibilities Design, develop and improve high-performance software systems using Rust. Investigate complex technical problems and deliver robust solutions with practical, real-world applications. Take ownership of projects across the development lifecycle, from technical planning and architectural decisions to implementation and refinement. Apply sound engineering practices to support memory safety, concurrency, performance and reliability. Work with colleagues to discuss design choices, share knowledge and contribute to a strong engineering culture. Continue developing your Rust expertise while helping build and maintain greenfield software. Benefits Join a well-backed, high-growth start-up working on innovative technology. Build greenfield software in an environment that deliberately prioritises performance, memory safety, concurrency and reliability. Work alongside highly skilled engineers and take meaningful ownership of challenging projects. Develop specialist expertise in Rust and contribute to software with real-world applications. The role also offers exposure to emerging technology interests, including AI and machine learning, within a fast-moving organisation. Equal Opportunity Oho Group Ltd and its client are committed to a fair and inclusive recruitment process. Applications are welcomed from qualified candidates of all backgrounds. Hiring decisions are based on relevant skills, experience, potential and role requirements, without discrimination on any legally protected basis.

review_candidates.description: Mechanisms Engineer - Solar Arrays Location: Germering, on-site About the hiring company: Dcubed is a fast-growing space engineering company with the mission to make space engineering and exploration easy and accessible. What makes Dcubed special is that each of us is a space explorer at heart. At Dcubed, we enable the future of space missions with high-performance, flight-proven release mechanisms and deployable structures. From cutting-edge Release Actuators to scalable Deployable Solar Arrays and innovative Deployable Antennas, our technologies are designed for user friendliness, availability, and reliability — whether for smallsats in LEO or large missions to Moon, Mars and beyond. About the role In space, there are no second chances. As Mechanisms Engineer – Solar Arrays (f/m/d) , you will be responsible for the deployment systems at the heart of dcubed's solar arrays. You will design, prototype, test, and qualify the hardware that allows spacecraft to generate power once they reach orbit. We are looking for an engineer with a builder's mindset: someone who can move seamlessly from CAD models and FEM analyses to the workshop and test lab, turning ambitious ideas into reliable flight hardware. If you are motivated by ownership, speed, and the challenge of making space mechanisms work where repair is impossible, you'll fit right in. Responsibilities Mechanism Design & Development: Design, analyze, and develop space-qualified deployment mechanisms and motion systems for Solar Array products, from concept through flight hardware delivery. Technical Expertise: Provide expert guidance on mechanism design, materials selection, lubrication, coatings, thermal effects, motorization margins, tolerancing, and reliability for space applications. Manufacturing & Prototyping: Apply Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles, generate production-ready technical drawings, and support rapid prototyping and manufacturing activities using additive manufacturing and conventional machining techniques. System Integration: Ensure seamless integration of mechanisms with structural, electrical, and deployment subsystems while balancing performance, manufacturability, cost, and schedule requirements. Testing & Qualification: Define, support, and execute development, qualification, and acceptance test campaigns, including deployment, vibration, thermal vacuum, shock, and lifetime testing. Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement: Investigate anomalies, perform root-cause analysis, and implement design improvements to enhance mechanism performance, reliability, and manufacturability. Documentation: Maintain engineering documentation including CAD models, technical drawings, specifications, analyses, test procedures, and qualification reports. Candidate requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. 5+ years of experience in mechanism design, aerospace engineering, precision mechanical systems, or related fields. Strong knowledge of space mechanisms, including bearings, gears, springs, hinges, release systems, lubrication, coatings, wear mechanisms, thermal effects, and motorization sizing and margins. Expert-level CAD proficiency (SolidWorks preferred) and familiarity with FEM tools (ANSYS preferred). Strong understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, GD&T, tolerancing, and technical drawing generation. Experience applying Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles. Hands-on experience with prototyping and fabrication methods including 3D printing, milling, turning, laser cutting, CNC machining, and hardware assembly. Familiarity with space qualification methods and standards, including vibration, shock, thermal vacuum, deployment, and lifetime testing. Knowledge of ECSS, NASA, or equivalent aerospace standards is highly desirable. Fluent English skills. Eligibility to work in Germany. Feel free to apply here or directly via https://dcubed.teamtailor.com/jobs/8186378-mechanisms-engineer-solar-arrays-f-m-d
